description: Our hearts are shattered by the tragedy at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis. In this moment of grief, we must also find the courage to act—with compassion, with unity, and with a commitment to protect our children and strengthen our communities.
paid_for_by: paid for by the Friends of Heather Holmes Committee P
title: Finding the Courage to Act: Statement on Annunciation Catholic School Shooting — Heather Holmes for MN House 24A
